description: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:sc081_validity_cap and pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:ValidityMaxLint correctly use the certificate's notBefore as the input to the phase lookup, not the relying-party's current time. SC-081 requires the cap in force at issuance to govern the cert for its lifetime. Using now_unix would retroactively invalidate pre-SC-081 certs after the phase boundary. The WebPkiProfile doc explains this clearly. A contributor might suggest adding max_validity_secs = Some(398*86400) to the policy; that must be resisted because it uses RP current time and would break pre-SC-081 certs after 2026-03-15.
title: SC-081 validity cap uses notBefore not relying-party time — semantically correct
